description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Many Faces.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Vizier of Many Faces and another permanent you control.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Vizier of Many Faces
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
